en.t: The brushwork was elegant and restrained, with only a few strokes of ink.
The prince read it aloud once in a clear voice.

units.source_text: 夕雾便把送信使者留住，赏赐酒肴甚丰。

en.t: Yugiri then kept the messenger there and treated him generously with wine and food.

units.source_text: 又送他女装一套，内有红梅色中国绸制常礼服一袭。

en.t: He also gave him a set of women's clothing, including a formal everyday robe made of Chinese silk in the color of red plum blossoms.

units.source_text: 源氏的复信也用红梅色染成的上深下渐淡的信纸，在庭中折取红梅一枝，将信系在枝上。

en.t: Genji's reply, too, was written on paper dyed red-plum color, deep at the top and gradually paler below; he broke off a branch of red plum in the garden and tied the letter to it.

units.source_text: 亲王恨恨地说：“我在猜测这封信的内容呢。

en.t: The prince said resentfully, "I am trying to guess what is in that letter.

units.source_text: 有什么隐情，要如此秘密？”

en.t: What hidden matter could there be that it must be kept so secret?"
He very much wanted to see the letter.

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“并无特别事由。

en.t: Genji replied, "There is no special reason.

units.source_text: 你把它看作隐情，岂有此理！”

en.t: It is absurd for you to treat it as some hidden affair!"

units.source_text: 便在另一张纸上将信中的诗写给他看：

en.t: Then he wrote the poem from the letter on another sheet of paper and showed it to him:
